card.name: Verb 'may' after a condition noun
card.fires_on: The word 'may' (or 'not') right after a condition noun such as tolerance, frank gout or hyperkalemia, where a verb like 'be' or 'develop' comes next. Also seen at the start of a Dutch word after a dictionary headword.

modes.label: 'may' after condition
modes.description: Modal 'may' following a side-effect or condition noun, before 'be precipitated', 'develop' or 'be found'.
